title.zh: 补齐观察、诊断与远程任务闭环
title.en: Added observation, diagnosis, and remote-task loop

summary.zh: AI 客户端可以在白泽账号权限和审批规则范围内完成运行概览、节点观察、运行态诊断、告警确认和远程任务全流程，结果保持有界、脱敏且可验证。
summary.en: AI clients can cover runtime overview, agent observation, runtime diagnosis, alert acknowledgement, and the full remote-task flow within Baize account permissions and approval rules, with bounded, redacted, verifiable results.

zh: 增加运行概览、节点有界观察、固定语义观察和只读运行态诊断工具。
补齐远程任务闭环：直接任务入口、待决任务派发和按需有界输出读取。
增加告警确认/解决、工作流状态与审批策略摘要、命令计划取消工具。
错误信息保留稳定的原因、可重试标记、消息键和下一步动作键。
AI 接入说明覆盖 DeepSeek Harness（DSH），最低兼容白泽版本更新为 0.2.2。
en: Adds runtime overview, bounded agent observation, fixed semantic observation, and read-only runtime diagnosis tools.
Closes the remote-task loop with the direct-task entry, pending-task dispatch, and on-demand bounded output reads.
Adds alert acknowledgement/resolution, workflow status with the approval-policy summary, and command-plan cancellation.
Keeps stable reason, retryable, message-key, and next-action fields in errors.
AI access documentation now covers DeepSeek Harness (DSH), and the minimum compatible Baize version is 0.2.2.

title.zh: 增加命令计划审批闭环

summary.zh: AI 客户端可以在白泽账号权限和审批规则范围内申请、查看并提交计划审批决定，同时保持执行前的独立确认。
summary.en: AI clients can request, inspect, and submit plan-approval decisions within Baize account permissions and approval rules while keeping execution as a separate confirmation.

zh: 增加审批申请、分页列表、详情和通过/驳回决策工具。
增加分页继续标记和 64 KiB 工具目录/结构化结果限制。
改进 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 的 AI 接入升级，并将源码构建最低版本更新为 Go 1.25.13。
en: Adds approval request, paginated listing, detail, and approve/reject decision tools.
Adds pagination continuation markers and 64 KiB tool-catalog and structured-result limits.
Improves AI access upgrades on Linux, macOS, and Windows, and raises the minimum source-build version to Go 1.25.13.

summary.zh: AI 客户端可以发现模板、预览计划、跟踪远程任务，并在白泽权限和确认流程允许时请求执行或取消。
summary.en: AI clients can discover templates, preview plans, track remote tasks, and request execution or cancellation when Baize permissions and confirmation flows allow it.

zh: 增加命令模板列表和不落地预览。
增加命令计划创建、查询和执行；创建计划不会直接派发。
增加远程任务查询和取消，结果不包含命令正文、环境变量或任务输出。
en: Adds command-template listing and non-dispatching previews.
Adds command-plan creation, inspection, and execution; creating a plan does not dispatch it.
Adds remote-task inspection and cancellation without returning command bodies, environment values, or task output.

summary.zh: AI 客户端可以按更多已验证条件筛选和排序白泽服务器节点，同时保持现有工具、登录方式与隐私保护结果兼容。
summary.en: AI clients can filter and sort Baize server agents with more verified conditions while keeping existing tools, sign-in, and privacy-protected outputs compatible.

zh: 支持按别名、系统、地区、架构、Agent 版本和分组筛选节点。
支持按创建时间、更新时间、最后心跳、注册时间、名称、状态、版本或系统排序。
保持三个只读工具名称、登录方式和结果字段边界兼容。
en: Filters agents by alias, system, region, architecture, Agent version, and group.
Sorts by creation time, update time, last heartbeat, registration time, name, status, version, or operating system.
Keeps the three read-only tool names, sign-in flow, and result field boundary compatible.

summary.zh: 通过安全的本机登录和三个只读工具，在 AI 软件、IDE 与终端客户端中查看经过隐私保护的白泽节点状态。
summary.en: Use secure local sign-in and three read-only tools to view privacy-protected Baize agent status from AI applications, IDEs, and terminal clients.

zh: 支持连接检查、节点分页列表和单节点基础状态。
支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 的 amd64 与 arm64 发布包。
发布包启动时自动校验可执行文件完整性。
en: Supports connection checks, paginated agent lists, and basic status for one agent.
Provides amd64 and arm64 archives for Linux, macOS, and Windows.
Automatically verifies executable integrity at startup.
